summary: The team is juggling the final push on the China Going-Global report with IE for a September launch, while also advancing the knowledge website redesign and prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs in SEO and marketing efforts.
summaryDetail: The most critical initiative right now is the joint CKGSB-IE report, 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global', which is on track for a September launch in Singapore. This week, Felix needs to prepare the one-pager proposal, and the team must meet with Tech in Asia to discuss distribution. Translation of the main research and alumni case studies is underway, and contributions from leadership are being confirmed. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward: Joseph and Julie need to finalize feedback and share the HTML file, incorporating Joseph's editorial elements to boost article visibility. For program promotion, the focus is on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting SEO target areas and analyzing participant profiles, while the SEO manager provides conversion tracking briefs. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook login issue affecting team communication, and ensure the mid-year performance review draft is sent to Ira by August 10. Upcoming: the SBA 2025 winner article publishes on WeChat on August 26, and decisions on social media agency and Global Foundation membership are pending.
